title: Sokoban
prompt:
Build Sokoban with at least 3 hand-made, solvable built-in levels. The player moves one cell per move; walking into a box pushes it when the cell behind it is free (no wall, no box). A level is solved when every box is on a goal: solved true and score +1 (score = levels solved). After a solved built-in level the next one loads after 60 ticks; solving the last built-in level or a level from loadLevel() ends the game. Undo reverts the last move; restart resets the level. Keyboard: arrows/WASD, Z undo, R restart. Touch: swipes of at least 30 px.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, level (1-based), moves, pushes, solved, cols, rows, player:{x,y}, boxes:[{x,y}], goals:[{x,y}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.move(dir): returns true when the player moved
- Game.input.undo(): returns false when there is nothing to undo
- Game.input.restart(): reset the current level
- Game.loadLevel(text): load standard Sokoban text (# wall, @ player, + player on goal, $ box, * box on goal, . goal, space floor; rows separated by newlines) as a one-level game in phase 'play'

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): level parsing, walking, pushing, blocking, solving, undo, restart, keyboard and swipes.
